conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a potential ~1.5%/month return. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4%/month. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentration in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

income.read: This income plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions, targeting ~1%/month. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta names, focusing on income and broad index ETFs. While aiming for lower drawdown, distributions are variable and NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
